skill.summary: Turn incoming text (email/newsletter) into a short TTS podcast with chunking + ffmpeg concat.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of podcastifier: turn text into a TTS podcast.

- Converts incoming text (email or newsletter) into a short podcast.
- Parses plain text or HTML and extracts story bullets.
- Chunks text safely for TTS generation, then concatenates with ffmpeg.
- Outputs an mp3 file with intro and outro.
- Command-line usage provided.
